about: Basic Pitch output for a synthetic phone recording at 100 BPM: E E E(6 beats, ringing) G G E E E E C(6 beats) D D E(4) G(4), strings beating as they ring and the phone turning its volume up as they fade, so the detector hears ringing notes start again; with the attack measured in the recording (withAttacks): [start s, duration s, MIDI, amplitude, attack dB].
